def sim.owned32.byte_order
  (left : alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8) (right : alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8)
  (at1 : Std.Usize) :
  Result Std.I8
  := do
  let i := alloc.vec.Vec.len left
  if at1 = i
  then
    let i1 := alloc.vec.Vec.len right
    if at1 = i1
    then ok 0#i8
    else ok (-1)#i8
  else
    let i1 := alloc.vec.Vec.len right
    if at1 = i1
    then ok 1#i8
    else
      let i2 ←
        alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice Std.U8) left
          at1
      let i3 ←
        alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice Std.U8)
          right at1
      if i2 < i3
      then ok (-1)#i8
      else
        if i2 > i3
        then ok 1#i8
        else
          let i4 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add at1 1#usize)
          sim.owned32.byte_order left right i4
partial_fixpoint

def sim.owned32.program_insert
  (table : alloc.vec.Vec ((alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8) × (Array Std.U8 32#usize)))
  (key : alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8) (value : Array Std.U8 32#usize)
  (at1 : Std.Usize)
  (out : alloc.vec.Vec ((alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8) × (Array Std.U8 32#usize)))
  (collision : Bool) :
  Result ((alloc.vec.Vec ((alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8) × (Array Std.U8 32#usize)))
    × Bool)
  := do
  let i := alloc.vec.Vec.len table
  if at1 = i
  then let out1 ← alloc.vec.Vec.push out (key, value)
       ok (out1, collision)
  else
    let p ←
      alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice
        ((alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8) × (Array Std.U8 32#usize))) table at1
    let (k, v) ←
      (BuiltinClone ((alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8) × (Array Std.U8 32#usize))).clone
        p
    let v1 ← alloc.vec.CloneVec.clone core.clone.CloneU8 key
    let v2 ← alloc.vec.CloneVec.clone core.clone.CloneU8 k
    let order ← sim.owned32.byte_order v1 v2 0#usize
    if order < 0#i8
    then
      let out1 ← alloc.vec.Vec.push out (key, value)
      let v3 ← sim.owned32.program_tail table at1 out1
      ok (v3, collision)
    else
      if order = 0#i8
      then
        let out1 ← alloc.vec.Vec.push out (key, value)
        let i1 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add at1 1#usize)
        let v3 ← sim.owned32.program_tail table i1 out1
        if collision
        then ok (v3, true)
        else
          let b ←
            core.array.equality.PartialEqArray.ne core.cmp.PartialEqU8 v value
          ok (v3, b)
      else
        let out1 ← alloc.vec.Vec.push out (k, v)
        let i1 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add at1 1#usize)
        sim.owned32.program_insert table key value i1 out1 collision
partial_fixpoint

def sim.owned32.merge_program
  (table : alloc.vec.Vec ((alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8) × (Array Std.U8 32#usize)))
  (reads : alloc.vec.Vec ((alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8) × (Array Std.U8 32#usize)))
  (at1 : Std.Usize) :
  Result (Option (alloc.vec.Vec ((alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8) × (Array Std.U8
    32#usize))))
  := do
  let i := alloc.vec.Vec.len reads
  if at1 = i
  then ok (some table)
  else
    let p ←
      alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice
        ((alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8) × (Array Std.U8 32#usize))) reads at1
    let (key, value) ←
      (BuiltinClone ((alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8) × (Array Std.U8 32#usize))).clone
        p
    let (table1, conflict) ←
      sim.owned32.program_insert table key value 0#usize (alloc.vec.Vec.new
        ((alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8) × (Array Std.U8 32#usize))) false
    if conflict
    then ok none
    else
      let i1 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add at1 1#usize)
      sim.owned32.merge_program table1 reads i1
